Synopsis:
Italy has extended its suspension of Schengen open-border arrangements with Spain for an additional 15 days, following a mass migrant crossing from Morocco into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta on July 30 (~72,000+ crossed; 96 confirmed deaths). Spain reciprocated with mirror checks on Italy-bound travel. The bilateral restrictions are eroding EU Schengen zone cohesion. Italy's PM Meloni faces domestic political pressure from the rising far-right party Futuro Nazionale ahead of upcoming elections, reinforcing her hard-line immigration stance.
